QuestInfo.name: [Commerci Republic] Screaming in the Night
QuestInfo.0: Things weren't going so well in San Commerci, so you decided to go out for a stroll.
QuestInfo.1: Things weren't going so well in San Commerci, so you decided to go out for a stroll. But you heard a scream, and found Zion on the ground, surrounded by what looked like assassins!
QuestInfo.2: While you were out walking the streets, you found Zion on the ground, surrounded by what looked like assassins! They were highly-trained, but they took off once they heard Gilberto's group heading this way.
